story:
Ethan had reached the treasure room in his favorite video game, but a giant red creature was blocking the golden chest. Although Ethan tried three different buttons, nothing worked.

[emotion:QT/sad] "I think I need help," Ethan said quietly, because he had never felt so stuck before.

His neighbor Ravi came over and sat beside him. Ravi had played this level before and remembered the trick.

"You have to throw the cheese block first, then run left," Ravi explained, pointing carefully at the corner of the screen.

[emotion:QT/surprised] "I always went right," Ethan said, surprised.

They took turns — Ethan threw the block while Ravi called out directions. After three tries, the creature chased the cheese and the chest swung open. The room filled with bright, glittery light, and both of them cheered so loudly that Ethan's dog ran in barking. [emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:emotions/hoora] Ethan felt something warm and proud in his chest, like sunshine behind a cloud. [emotion:QT/happy]

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his video game treasure chest?
questions.correct_answer: Asking a friend for help can save the day
wrong_answers: Ethan was the best video game player
The treasure chest was too hard to reach

questions.question: What did Ravi say Ethan had to throw first, before the creature would chase after it?
After Ethan threw the block and the creature chased the cheese, what happened to the treasure chest?
questions.correct_answer: It swung open and the room filled with bright, glittery light
wrong_answers: The creature guarded it even more
Ethan ran right and grabbed the chest

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan felt something warm and proud in his chest, like sunshine behind a cloud?
questions.correct_answer: Because he asked for help and they reached the treasure together
wrong_answers: Because he beat the level all by himself
Because his dog ran in and made them laugh

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Ethan had not asked Ravi for help with the creature?
questions.correct_answer: He would have stayed stuck and never reached the treasure
wrong_answers: He would have thrown the cheese block on his own
The creature would have moved away by itself

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to say he needed help?
questions.correct_answer: Asking for help when you're stuck is a really smart thing to do.
wrong_answers: Trying every button on your own will always solve the problem in the end.
Watching someone else play is the best way to learn a new video game.

questions.question: What can you learn from their behavior?
questions.correct_answer: Taking turns and working together helps you solve hard problems faster.
wrong_answers: Letting the most experienced person handle everything gets the best results.
Practicing a difficult level over and over by yourself is the quickest way to win.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story?
questions.correct_answer: Friends make even tricky challenges more fun.
wrong_answers: Winning a game feels best when you figure out the answer completely on your own.
Playing video games is more exciting when you compete against each other.
